title: Scott Crane meets Eric Walker of Majestic 12

tellings.quote: there's this guy Scott Crane who met with this guy Eric Walker who he thought was in the Majestic 12, right? >> And Scott Crane had this >> he just converted to Christianity, became hardcore Christian and like forgot about the whole thing.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a man named Scott Crane who met a man named Eric Walker, who Crane believed belonged to Majestic 12, a secret group said to control what the US government knows about UFOs. According to Michels, Crane then became a devout Christian and dropped the whole matter, a story that hints at how unsettling such a meeting might be.
